description: Paraphrase queries over Content/Claims: sentence-length natural-language restatements of each claim written to avoid its title words (the kind of query the extracting/enriching skills send). Single expected claim each; other claims may be reasonable hits, so scores are a lower bound.

queries.query: feeling at peace means accepting and combining every side of who you are
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Achieving internal harmony requires integrating all parts of yourself

queries.query: being able to actually do the things you want
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Agency is the ability to connect desires and actions

queries.query: when a skill becomes habitual its flaws get locked in
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Automation of skill makes weaknesses permanent

queries.query: we can't see our own flaws without someone else's view
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Blind spots require external perspective to surface

queries.query: things shift abruptly after enough small pressure builds up
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Change happens suddenly once a threshold is crossed

queries.query: the idea matters, not whether it arrives as a book, a video or a podcast
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Content is independent from the medium that transmits it

queries.query: setting checkpoints in advance makes you stop and reconsider
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Decision points force re-evaluation or action by creating deliberate triggers

queries.query: long-lasting hopelessness that comes from feeling powerless and purposeless
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Depression is chronic despair from helplessness and lost meaning

queries.query: chasing shiny new things keeps us from sticking with anything long enough
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Distraction by novelty undermines commitment and depth

queries.query: moods are catching, we pick up how the people around us feel

queries.query: spending money on trips and events makes us happier than buying stuff

queries.query: why being turned down by others feels so threatening to who we are

queries.query: turning chores into games makes people want to do them

queries.query: tiny jobs should be done right away rather than put on a list

queries.query: gut feelings are really experience that became instant
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Intuition is trained expertise converted to automatic response

queries.query: in some contests you win by not screwing up, not by being brilliant

queries.query: too much irrelevant information makes it hard to see what's real
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Noise obscures truth with external interference and confusion

queries.query: a strong inner drive keeps you going when things get hard

queries.query: what looks like chance is just us not knowing all the causes
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Randomness may be an illusion created by incomplete knowledge

queries.query: hurrying leads to poorer results than waiting
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Rushing produces worse outcomes than patience

queries.query: you have to believe in yourself before you can rely on other people
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Self-trust is the first step to trusting others

queries.query: going deep on one narrow field turns you into an expert
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Specialization develops deep expertise by focusing narrowly on a domain

queries.query: the initial figure mentioned shapes how we judge every later one
queries.description: Paraphrase of: The first number sets the frame for all that follow

queries.query: hangouts that are neither home nor work hold neighborhoods together
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Third places anchor community connection

queries.query: people stick with the preset option instead of changing it
queries.description: Paraphrase of: We tend to accept defaults and rarely override them

queries.query: free, unorganised fun is how kids and adults learn and invent
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Unstructured play drives learning and creativity

queries.query: the wording we choose changes what people think of a thing

queries.query: seeing material again and again helps it stick in the mind

queries.query: getting enough rest keeps the brain sharp and effective
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Sleep is essential for cognitive function and peak performance

queries.query: staying receptive to fresh thinking like a beginner would

queries.query: each person's mind colors what they take the world to be
queries.description: Paraphrase of: Subjective perception filters how we see external reality
